Subject Pro-Wang Ching Wei Posters posted in Nantao.

Made by D. I. Fan Lien Pih. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

Printed posters of a pro-Wang Ching Wei
nature were posted in that part of Nantao adjacent to
the French Concession during the afternoon of April 23
by coolies from the Nantao Tenants' Association (No. 1,
Lane 82, Tsing Lien Ka (青蓮街), Kiu Mou Dien, Nantao).
These posters purport to have emanated from
the "Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Suppression Committee of
the Central Executive Committee of the Chinese Kuomin-
tang" (Wang Ching Wei sponsored), 75 Jessfield Road,
and contain the following slogans :-
1. Prosperity depends upon peace and good
order which cannot be realized without
first annihilating guerillas!
2. Communists attempt to fool the people
by stating that they are conducting
guerilla warfare!
3. If you join the guerillas, you will become
a useless citizen and have no future!
4. Those guerillas who love their country
and native place, should give up their
arms and return to their farms!
Each poster bears the photograph of the late Dr. Sun Yat
Sen and Mr. Wang Ching Wei, and also the inscription,
"National Re-construction comes by overthrowing communists
and Restoring Peace".
The Nantao Tenants' Association, No. 1, Lane
82, Tsing Lien Ka (青蓮街), Kiu Mou Dien, Nantao, was
organized by the tenants in Nantao during March, 1940,

S.I., Special Branch
REPORT
Date March 21, 1940.
Subject. Propaganda in support of New Central Government.
Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by Supt. Mason

On March 20, 1940, copies of paper posters purporting to have emanated from the Kiangsu Provincial Tangwu of the Kuomintang of China (Wang Ching Wei sponsored) and containing slogans in support of the proposed new Central Government were found posted in various streets in Jessfield area. The following are some of the slogans:-
1. Support the meeting of the Central Political Council.
2. The Central Political Council will decide the enforcement of the constitution.
3. The Central Political Council will organize a democratic administration for the country.
4. The Central Political Council will establish independence and secure equality for the country.
5. Welcome Wang Ching Wei's return to Nanking and assumption of control of the Government.

It will be noted that the Central Political Council convened a meeting in Nanking yesterday, March 20, 1940, when representatives of Wang Ching Wei's party, Reformed Government and the Provisional Government of North China were present and a resolution to inaugurate the New Central Government in Nanking on March 30, 1940, was passed.

Liao Chung Chien
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

1940年3月20日，在极司菲尔路地区各街道发现张贴有纸质海报副本，声称发自中国国民党江苏省党务机构（汪精卫赞助），内容包含支持拟议中的新中央政府的标语。部分标语如下：
1. 支持中央政治委员会会议。
2. 中央政治委员会将决定宪法的实施。
3. 中央政治委员会将为国家组建民主政府。
4. 中央政治委员会将确立国家独立并保障平等。
5. 欢迎汪精卫返回南京并执掌政府。

值得注意的是，中央政治委员会于昨日，即1940年3月20日，在南京召开会议，汪精卫党派、维新政府及华北临时政府的代表均出席，并通过决议，定于1940年3月30日在南京成立新中央政府。

Attached herewith is a copy of a booklet in
English entitled "Asiatic Regeneration and National
Reconstruction" by one Yen Chun Kuang (嚴軍光),
which was delivered through the post to Hongkew
Station, the postal cancellation chop being illegible.
It contains 20 short articles dealing with the general

ment as advocated by the Japanese Government including
one (article No. 4) which accuses Great Britain and
the U.S.S.R. of being the instigators of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities. Enquiries have been made by
this office as regards whether an organization is in
existence for promoting the "Asiatic Regeneration and
National Reconstruction Movement" but without result.
The author of the booklet is also not previously known
to the Police.

page_data.en:
Translation of a handbill entitled "Open Letter to the
Chinese People in Shanghai on the Occasion of the Chinese
New Year of the Lunar Calender" purporting to emanate from
the Asia Development and National Reconstruction Movement
Headquarters :-

Almost three years have elapsed since the outbreak
of the August 13 incident in 1937. More than a half of the
national territory has fallen, and the people have been
rendered homeless. The old and weak have buried themselves
in ditches and streams, while the young and stout have died
on the battlefield. Both Nantao and Chapei have been
converted into scorched land, and it is with deep grief that
we should be faced such an unprecedented calamity.

Following the withdrawal of Chinese troops in a
westerly direction, Shanghai immediately became an isolated
city. Several millions of Chinese brethren have failed to
bring to their mind the seriousness of the national crisis;
some abandon themselves to pleasures while others take
refuge in the Foreign Settlements, which are under the
aggressive influence of the European and American Powers,
without the slightest idea of the ambition of the European
and American Imperialism and of the sinister plot of the
U.S.S.R. to sovietize China. However, the U.S.S.R. has
exposed her plot through her existing attitude to profit
herself by taking advantage of the dispute between China
and Japan. Lest her attempt to oppress East Asia should
fail when the Sino-Japanese hostilities cease and the peace
in East Asia materializes, she has been carrying out her
activities under the cloak of opposition to aggression and
assistance to China, as witness the three years' war of
resistance which has been put up, but not of China's own
volition.
page_data.zh:
题为《值此农历新年之际致上海中国人民的公开信》的传单译文，声称发自亚洲发展与国家重建运动总部：

自1937年八一三事变爆发以来，已近三年。国土过半沦陷，百姓流离失所。老弱填沟壑，壮烈死沙场。南市与闸北皆化为焦土，面对此空前浩劫，我们深感悲痛。

随着中国军队向西撤退，上海立即成为孤岛。数百万同胞未能意识到国家危机的严重性；有的沉溺于享乐，有的避难于受欧美列强侵略性影响的外国租界，对欧美帝国主义的野心及苏联赤化中国的阴谋毫无察觉。然而，苏联已通过其现有态度暴露了其阴谋，即利用中日争端谋取私利。唯恐当中日敌对行动停止、东亚和平实现时，其压迫东亚的企图失败，苏联一直打着反对侵略和援助中国的幌子进行活动，正如这三年非出于中国自愿的抗战所见证的那样。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Unfortunately, at this critical juncture in
the national situation, certain persons are still supporting
the policy of national reconstruction through the war of
resistance. However, judging by the present situation,
an extension of hostilities will only bring about more
hardships to the people. Efforts have been repeatedly
made to secure support from European and American Powers,
but without result, while the date of a final victory is
far and away. It is therefore but empty talk to attempt
national reconstruction through the war of resistance.

China belongs to the Chinese. All descendants
of Emperor Huang Ti should come to their senses and establish,
with united strength and efforts, a sound foundation for
their fatherland. East Asia belongs to the East Asiatic
peoples. Both the Chinese and Japanese peoples should
unite and forget the hostile feelings between them; they
should instead plan good relations with sincerity, thereby
securing a permanent peace in East Asia.

The Asia development and national reconstruction
movement being an urgent business, we Chinese are under
obligation to make every effort to accelerate the
accomplishment of this business.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

不幸的是，在国家局势的关键时刻，某些人仍支持通过抗战进行国家重建的政策。然而， judging by the present situation（鉴于当前局势），延长敌对行动只会给人民带来更多苦难。多次努力寻求欧美列强的支持，但均无结果，而最终胜利的日期遥遥无期。因此，试图通过抗战进行国家重建不过是空谈。

中国属于中国人。所有黄帝子孙应清醒过来，团结力量与努力，为祖国奠定坚实基础。东亚属于东亚人民。中日两国人民应团结起来，忘却彼此间的敌意；相反，应以诚意规划良好关系，从而确保东亚的永久和平。

亚洲发展与国家重建运动乃当务之急，我们中国人有义务竭尽全力加速完成此项事业。

FEB 1 5 1940

Ta Mei Pao :-

PROPAGANDA DISTRIBUTED IN SPURIOUS ENVELOPES OF "TA MEI PAO"

Copies of coloured handbills and slogans
bearing the name of the Asia Development and National
Reconstruction Movement Headquarters enclosed in fictitious
envelopes of the "Ta Mei Pao" were received through the
post by all the local newspaper officers yesterday. The
handbills and slogans contain nothing but the usual
propaganda for the peace movement. In addition to the name
of the "Ta Mei Pao" and its address and telephone number,
the envelopes were further inscribed with the words: "New
Year Greetings," an attempt evidently aimed at misleading
the recipients. It is not only shameless but also
regrettable that the so-called Asia Development and
National Reconstruction Movement Headquarters should,
instead of conducting its propaganda openly, have resorted
to the illegal use of the name of this paper.
It is learned that in some cases envelopes
bearing the name of the "Chinese-American Daily News" were
used for the delivery of such handbills and slogans, on
which were also inscribed the words: "New Year Greetings."

1940年2月15日

《大美报》：

装在假冒《大美报》信封内散发的宣传品

昨日，本地各报社通过邮政收到装有彩色传单和标语的副本，署名为亚洲发展与国家重建运动总部，信封为假冒的《大美报》信封。传单和标语内容无非是和平运动的常规宣传。除了《大美报》的名称、地址和电话号码外，信封上还印有“新年贺词”字样，这显然是为了误导收件人。所谓亚洲发展与国家重建运动总部不公开进行宣传，反而非法使用本报名称，此举不仅无耻，而且令人遗憾。
据悉，在某些情况下，此类传单和标语是使用印有《中美日报》名称的信封投递的，上面也印有“新年贺词”字样。

Translation of a handbill entitled "Open Letter to the
Chinese People in Shanghai on the Occasion of the Chinese
New Year of the Lunar Calender" purporting to emanate from
the Asia Development and National Reconstruction Movement
Headquarters:-

Almost three years have elapsed since the outbreak
of the August 13 incident in 1937. More than a half of the
national territory has fallen, and the people have been
rendered homeless. The old and weak have buried themselves
in ditches and streams, while the young and stout have died
on the battlefield. Both Nantao and Chapei have been
converted into scorched land, and it is with deep grief
that we should be faced such an unprecedented calamity.

Following the withdrawal of Chinese troops in a
westerly direction, Shanghai immediately became an isolated
city. Several millions of Chinese brethren have failed to
bring to their mind the seriousness of the national crisis;
some abandon themselves to pleasures while others take
refuge in the Foreign Settlements, which are under the
aggressive influence of the European and American Powers,
without the slightest idea of the ambition of the European
and American Imperialism and of the sinister plot of the
U.S.S.R. to sovietize China. However, the U.S.S.R. has
exposed her plot through her existing attitude to profit
herself by taking advantage of the dispute between China
and Japan. Lest her attempt to oppress East Asia should
fail when the Sino-Japanese hostilities cease and the peace
in East Asia materializes, she has been carrying out her
activities under the cloak of opposition to aggression and
assistance to China, as witness the three years' war of
resistance which has been put up, but not of China's own
volition.
page_data.zh:
据称出自兴亚建国运动本部的题为《值此农历新年之际致上海华人公开信》的传单译文：——

自1937年八一三事变爆发以来，已近三年。国土沦丧过半，百姓流离失所。老弱填沟壑，壮烈死沙场。南市与闸北皆化为焦土，面对此空前浩劫，吾人深感悲痛。

随着中国军队向西撤退，上海立即成为一座孤岛。数百万同胞未能意识到国家危机之严重；有的沉溺于享乐，有的则避难于受欧美列强侵略性影响的外国租界，对欧美帝国主义之野心及苏联使中国苏维埃化的阴险图谋毫无察觉。然而，苏联已通过其现有态度暴露了其图谋，即利用中日争端从中渔利。唯恐当中日敌对行动停止、东亚和平实现时，其压迫东亚的企图失败，故一直打着反对侵略和援助中国的幌子进行活动，正如这三年来的抗战所见证的那样，但这并非出于中国自身的意愿。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Unfortunately, at this critical juncture in the
national situation, certain persons are still supporting
the policy of national reconstruction through the war of
resistance. However, judging by the present situation,
an extension of hostilities will only bring about more
hardships to the people. Efforts have been repeatedly
made to secure support from European and American Powers,
but without result, while the date of a final victory is
far and away. It is therefore but empty talk to attempt
national reconstruction through the war of resistance.

China belongs to the Chinese. All descendants of
Emperor Huang Ti should come to their senses and establish,
with united strength and efforts, a sound foundation for
their fatherland. East Asia belongs to the East Asiatic
peoples. Both the Chinese and Japanese peoples should
unite and forget the hostile feelings between them; they
should instead plan good relations with sincerity, thereby
securing a permanent peace in East Asia.

The Asia development and national reconstruction
movement being an urgent business, we Chinese are under
obligation to make every effort to accelerate the
accomplishment of this business.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

不幸的是，在国家局势的这一关键时刻，仍有人支持“通过抗战建国”的政策。然而， judging by the present situation（鉴于当前局势），延长战事只会给人民带来更多的苦难。多次努力寻求欧美列强的支持，但均无结果，而最终胜利之日遥遥无期。因此，试图通过抗战来建国不过是空谈。

中国属于中国人。所有黄帝子孙应当醒悟，团结力量，为祖国奠定坚实的基础。东亚属于东亚人民。中日两国人民应当团结起来，忘却彼此间的敌意；相反，应以诚意谋划良好关系，从而确保东亚的永久和平。

兴亚建国运动乃当务之急，我中华儿女有义务竭尽全力加速完成此项事业。

Three years have elapsed since the outbreak of

more than half of the territories of the country has

to live in the foreign-protected settlements.

Lunar New Year Circular Letter to the Shanghai Citizens.
Three years have elapsed since the August 13th Incident. Half
of the China's territory has been lost and people forcibly
dispersed from their places of nativity. Aged people lost
their life in the trenches or war area, whilst able bodied
youths sacrificed their life on the frontier. Blocks of
houses were burnt to the ground and everywhere there is a
heart-rending plight. Since the Nationalist army withdrew,
Shanghai has been a lonely island. Millions of our confreres
have effaced the seriousness of national crises and resumed
their night life. They are of the opinion that they are under
the protection of the Settlement which is under the influence
of Europeans and Americans. However, the Communists' intrigue
to sovietize China is known to the public, whilst the ambition
of the European and American Imperialism remains unknown.
They are afraid that they can gain no more profit if the
Sino-Japanese hostilities come to an end or if the East
Asia's peace comes into reality. Therefore, they shout
'Down with aggression' and 'Give assistance to China'. At
present it is the time for those who insist on 'Rebirth of
China by resistance' to awake. Look ! Each request made to
European nations or U.S.A. for assistance met with no
satisfaction. Therefore, the 'ultimate victory' will never
come as expected. As a matter of fact, it is to deceive

past hatred and consolidate with sincerity. They should

致上海市民的新春通函。
自“八一三”事变以来已过去三年。中国半壁江山沦丧，
人民被迫背井离乡。老人在战壕或战区丧生，而身强力壮
的青年则在边疆牺牲。成片的房屋被烧毁，到处是令人
心碎的惨状。自从国军撤退后，上海已成一座孤岛。我们
的数百万同胞无视国家危机的严重性，恢复了夜生活。
他们认为自己在受欧美影响的租界保护之下。然而，公众
已知晓共产党苏维埃化中国的阴谋，而欧美帝国主义的
野心仍不为人知。他们担心，如果中日敌对行动结束或
东亚和平成为现实，他们将无法再获利。因此，他们高呼
‘打倒侵略’和‘援助中国’。现在是那些坚持‘抗战建国’
的人觉醒的时候了。看！向欧洲各国或美国请求援助均未
得到满意回应。因此，‘最后胜利’绝不会如预期那样到来。
事实上，相信“抗战建国”论调是自欺欺人。中国属于中国人，
因此黄帝子孙应当觉醒并团结起来，为祖国建立坚不可摧
的基础。东亚属于生活在东亚的人。中日两大民族应当忘却
过去的仇恨，真诚地巩固关系。他们应当为东亚的永久和平
竭诚协商。因此，‘民族复兴与亚洲振兴运动’是当务之急。

1938年12月12日

西区出现“壁报”

新政权效仿共产党手法

据昨日《大陆新报》报道，汪精卫先生赞助的“和平救国运动”追随者，窃取了其公敌——共产党人的宣传页码，在上海西区使用了“壁报”。
这家日本日报称，周日可以看到成群感兴趣的中国人聚集在各条主要街道上，阅读张贴在墙上的印刷品。右上角是中华民国国父孙中山博士的笑脸肖像，凡是使用过邮票的人都对此熟悉。
报纸详细报道了周六中央军官学校的成立情况，并引用了汪先生及其他人在场合上的讲话。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I. Special Branch
REPORT
Date December 4, 39.
Subject Wang Ching Wei's Kuomintang - propaganda.
Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

The Kuomintang formed by the Wang Ching Wei
Clique has formed an organization known as "Political
Training Department of the Kiangsu-Chekiang Suppression
Committee of the Kuomintang of China" (中國國民黨江浙
肅清委員會訓練處) with Waung Mei Yung (汪曼雲),
former Secretary of the local Tangpu, in charge.
This new body has established an office at 75 Jess-
field Road which is opposite 76 Jessfield Road, the
Headquarters of the Special Service Corps of the
Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National
Salvation Army. House No.75 Jessfield Road, it will
be recalled, was formerly occupied by the Theosophical
Society and was taken over by the corps on November 1,
1939.

It is reported that the "Political Training
Department of Kiangsu-Chekiang Suppression Committee
of the Kuomintang of China" has for its object the
promotion of pro-Wang Ching Wei, anti-Chiang Kai Shek
and anti-Communist propaganda.

On December 3 and 4, 1939, wall papers entitled
"Wall Paper of the Masses" (大衆壁報), purporting
to have emanated from this organization were found
posted on a wall opposite the Western District Police
Bureau, Nos. 11 & 13, Jessfield Road, O.O.L.. These
papers, apart from containing a number of articles
denouncing Gen. Chiang Kai Shek and the communists,
carry several cartoons of a similar nature.

D.C. (Special Branch)
Liao Chung Chien
D.S.I.

日期：1939年12月4日。
事由：汪精卫系国民党 - 宣传。
制作人：副督察长 廖仲坚 转呈人：督察长 Crawford

汪精卫派系组成的国民党已成立一个名为“中国国民党江浙肃清委员会训练处”（中國國民黨江浙肅清委員會訓練處）的组织，由前当地党部秘书汪曼云（Waung Mei Yung）负责。
这一新机构在极司菲尔路75号设立了办事处，该址对面是极司菲尔路76号，即“中国国民党反共救国军特别服务队”总部。回想起来，极司菲尔路75号原由神智学社占用，后于1939年11月1日被该服务队接管。

据报道，“中国国民党江浙肃清委员会训练处”的目标是推行拥汪精卫、反蒋介石及反共宣传。

1939年12月3日和4日，发现题为《大众壁报》（大衆壁報）的墙报张贴在西区捕房对面的墙上，地址为极司菲尔路11号和13号，O.O.L.。这些墙报声称出自该组织。除了包含多篇谴责蒋介石将军和共产党的文章外，还刊登了几幅类似性质的漫画。

page_data.en:
Summarized translation of pro-Wang Ching-wei
handbill entitled "Letter to Brethren from
the Peace Party of Pro-Wang Youth".

Brethren,

During the current hostilities, we have suffered
heavily and have been deprived of our properties. We are
also unable to locate our next of kin and we cannot go back
to our farms. We have gained nothing by this sacrifice and
we now realise it is foolish to sacrifice our all for the
individual benefit of the Chiang regime. The following facts
give a ready explanation:-

The capture of Shanghai and Woosung took place
only three months after the outbreak of the present hostilities.
Strategic excuses are lame excuses. The cities along the
Nanking-Shanghai Line fell one after another with the same
excuse being given. It goes without saying that Nanking,
Metropolis of our country, is an important stronghold. Daung
Sung Ts, the Nanking Garrison Commander, emphasized that
before Nanking fell, he would die for the city but the city was
abandoned without resistence. No sooner had Nanking fallen
than the strategic points, Wuhan, Nanchang, Canton ....... etc.
also shared the same fate with the same lame excuses of a
strategic retreat. The prominent figures of the Chiang regime
then removed to Chungking and the people were left and forgotten
about without protection.

Just imagine, the Chiang regime gave their lame
excuses only after a city was abandoned. Nobody believes that
the Wuhan area and Canton were not worth defending. Briefly,
the Chiang regime will assume no responsibility for the
salvation of the people and is gambling in a war at the cost
of those people.
page_data.zh:
题为《拥汪青年和平党敬告同胞书》的拥汪精卫传单摘要译文。

同胞们，

在当前战事中，我们遭受重创，财产被剥夺。我们也无法找到直系亲属，且无法返回家园。这种牺牲毫无所得，我们现在意识到，为了蒋氏政权的个人利益而牺牲一切是愚蠢的。以下事实给出了清晰的解释：-

上海和吴淞的陷落仅发生在当前战事爆发后的三个月。战略借口是站不住脚的借口。京沪线沿线城市相继沦陷，给出的都是同样的借口。不言而喻，南京作为我国首都，是一个重要据点。南京卫戍司令唐生智（Daung Sung Ts，音译）强调，在南京陷落前他将誓死守城，但该城却在未作抵抗的情况下被放弃。南京刚一陷落，武汉、南昌、广州等战略要地……等等，也因同样的战略性撤退的拙劣借口而遭遇同样命运。随后，蒋氏政权的显要人物撤往重庆，人民被遗弃和遗忘，无人保护。

试想，蒋氏政权只有在放弃一座城市后才给出其拙劣的借口。没有人相信武汉地区和广州不值得防守。简言之，蒋氏政权不承担拯救人民的责任，而是以人民为代价进行战争赌博。

page_data.en:
2 2 -

Mr. Wang Ching-wei, Deputy Executive of
the Central Government fully comprehends the weak points
in the Chungking Government and is impatient at the
worthless sacrifice. He has boldly risked his life in
an endeavour to further a peace national salvation
programme.

Brethren! We have undergone a lot of hardships
and now it is time for us to come to our sense by supporting
Mr. Wang Ching-wei's peace movement with a united front.

1) Support Chairman Wang in carrying out the
peace movement and the inauguration of a
new Central Government!
2) Long live the Kuomintang!
3) Long live the Republic of China!
page_data.zh:
2 2 -

中央政府副总裁汪精卫先生充分理解重庆政府的弱点，并对无谓的牺牲感到焦急。他大胆冒生命危险，致力于推进和平救国方案。

同胞们！我们经历了许多苦难，现在是我们清醒过来，以统一战线支持汪精卫先生和平运动的时候了。

1) 支持汪主席开展和平运动并 inaugurate（成立）新中央政府！
2) 国民党万岁！
3) 中华民国万岁！

REPORT
Date Oct. 2. 1939.
Subject Wang Ching Wei's Central Kuomintang - Propaganda through
broadcasting stations.
Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by

Mr. Chu Foh Chun (朱福銓), Manager of the
Li Shu Tuh Tang Broadcasting Station and concurrently
one of the Committee members of the Shanghai Private
Broadcasting Stations' Guild, was communicated with
at 12 noon on October 2 in connection with the
delivery of letters and gramophone records containing
propaganda in favour of Wang Ching Wei, to the local
broadcasting stations. Mr. Chu stated that the
letters and gramophone records were not delivered
through the Guild but were sent direct by the
Propaganda Department of the Central Executive Committee
of the Kuomintang of China. He continued that the
Guild had however received a despatch from the Radio
Broadcasting Control Office instructing the radio
stations to broadcast the gramophone record in
question, and in turn had passed the instructions
to the radio stations which are members of the Guild.
He concluded that the Guild did not know whether the
stations had complied with the instructions because
no reply had yet been received regarding the matter.
The Private Radio Broadcasting Stations'
Guild, formerly at Room A6, 1st floor, 119 Nanking
Road, is now situated in the Li Shu Tuh Tang Broadcasting
Station, Room 316, Shanghai New Hotel, 579 Kiukiang
Road. The removal was not reported to the Municipal
Police.

R.W. Mac Adie.
D.S.I.
D.C. (Special Branch)

10月2日中午12时，就向本地广播电台递送含有拥汪精卫宣传内容的信件和留声机唱片一事，与丽都花园广播电台经理兼上海私营广播电台同业公会委员之一的朱福铨（Chu Foh Chun）先生进行了联系。朱先生表示，信件和留声机唱片并非通过公会递送，而是由中国国民党中央执行委员会宣传部直接发送。他接着说，然而公会收到了无线电广播管制处的公函，指示各广播电台广播上述留声机唱片，公会随即将指示转达给属于公会成员的广播电台。他最后表示，公会不知道各电台是否遵从了指示，因为尚未收到关于此事的回复。
私营广播电台同业公会原址位于南京路119号二楼A6室，现迁至九江路579号上海新饭店316室丽都花园广播电台内。此次搬迁未向工部局警务处报告。

R.W. Mac Adie.

Subject Wang Ching Wei's Central Kuomintang - Propaganda.
Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by

During the past three days, local broadcast stations have been in receipt of letters purporting to have been emanated from the "Propaganda Department of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang of China" (中國國民黨中央執行委員會宣傳部).
A gramophone record containing the text of a speech on the subject of "We should follow the way towards revival of China and Asia" by Wang Ching Wei was also received with the letter.

The letter, a translation of which reads as follows, urges the recipients to broadcast the speech over their respective stations:-
"............. radio station,
"Forwarded herewith is a gramophone "record which contains the text of a speech "entitled 'We should follow the way towards "the revival of China and Asia' by President "Wang Ching Wei. You are kindly requested "to broadcast same over your station."
Chopped: Propaganda Department of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang of China."

Enquiries have ascertained that the letters and gramophone records were delivered to the radio stations by persons of the coolie class.

The radio stations in receipt of such gramophone records have referred the matter to the Shanghai Municipality Private Broadcasting Station Guild,

occupied since July 15, 1939, by the "Sin Shih Chi"

fortnightly) Magazine Office. The "Sin Shih Chi"

confidential information obtained from a reliable
source, the premises is in reality a branch of the
Propaganda Department of the Wang Ching-wei Clique.

is publishing a book in English on a speech made by
Wang Ching-wei on the peace movement and will
distribute free of charge copies of same to local
foreign community, including the foreign newspaper
offices.

report referring to one Mr. Sih (Tel. 12236), Apartment
405, 160 Avenue Edward VII, arranging on behalf of
Wang Ching-wei a tea party given to some distinguished
foreign journalists, enquiries reveal that the full
name of this Mr. Sih is Sih Dzu-sung (薛汝升)
(Shi Lo-sing in Mandarin), who is the chief editor

The First Propaganda Meeting

In Shanghai, the propaganda activities of the Nanking
Government have been undertaken by local pro-Wang papers
under the direction and sponsorship of the Ministry of
Publicity of the Nanking Government. Due to lack of
co-operation between pro-Wang papers and the public bodies
or official organs, the result has not been as satisfactory
as desired. Therefore, the First Propaganda Meeting was
held on 8/8/41 and 9/8/41 in the Shanghai Special Municipal
Government under the direction of Mayor Chen Kung-po and
the supervision of Koo Yung Ching (古泳今) appointed
by the Ministry of Publicity of the Nanking Government,
for the purpose of discussing ways and means to improve
the peace propaganda in Shanghai. The meeting, which was
attended by some 50 representatives of the subordinate
official organs, pro-Wang papers, schools, etc., passed
the following resolutions:-

(1) To print serial pictures so as to facilitate peace
movement propaganda under the auspices of the
bureaux of Education and Social Affairs.
(2) The Shanghai Special Municipal Government to issue
notifications to all public bodies and official
organs to contact at any time with the various local
broadcasting stations.
(3) To establish public newspaper reading rooms in
districts with a large population. That the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government instruct all the
administrative offices to negotiate with the news-
paper offices in establishing the reading rooms.
(4) To forbid any compulsory sale of the peace movement
newspapers by hooligans through the Shanghai Special
Municipal Government Police and the Western District
Special Police.

第一次宣传会议

在上海，南京政府的宣传活动由本地亲汪报纸在南京政府宣传部的指导和赞助下进行。由于亲汪报纸与公共团体或官方机构之间缺乏合作，结果不如预期令人满意。因此，第一次宣传会议于1941年8月8日和9日在上海特别市政府举行，由市长陈公博指导，并由南京政府宣传部任命的古泳今（古泳今）监督，目的是讨论改善上海和平宣传的方法和手段。出席会议的有下属官方机构、亲汪报纸、学校等的约50名代表，通过了以下决议：-

(1) 在教育和社会事务局的主持下，印制连环画，以促进和平运动宣传。
(2) 上海特别市政府向所有公共团体和官方机构发出通知，要求随时与各本地广播电台联系。
(3) 在人口密集地区建立公共阅报室。上海特别市政府指示各行政办公室与报社协商建立阅报室事宜。
(4) 通过上海特别市政府警察局和西区特别警察，禁止流氓强制推销和平运动报纸。
